purpose: Decide one closed formula in an explicitly finite Boolean language without promoting that result to theoremhood or truth for ERCF-3, HoTT or the host system.

input.available_information: complete finite syntax and total evaluator

time_structure.temporal_order: evaluation order is internal and terminating

completion.criterion_ref: return the Boolean result with equality certificate

prohibited_extra_information: no truth predicate for ObjectSyntax.Fml, HoTT propositions or arbitrary programs
obligations: the finite domain must be explicit
the false literal negative control must be rejected as true

known_positive_controls.description: true implies true evaluates to true

known_negative_controls.description: the false literal does not evaluate to true

correspondence.original_activity: decide a finite closed Boolean formula
correspondence.observation_justification: the semantic domain is declared before search
correspondence.reality_bridge_detail: The finite evaluator is not a general truth or theoremhood decider.
